story.fullStory:
Old Crow Medicine Show's "Wagon Wheel" — original release 2018. "Wagon Wheel" is a song co-written by Bob Dylan and Ketch Secor of Old Crow Medicine Show.

Dylan recorded the chorus in 1973 while Secor added verses 25 years later.

Old Crow Medicine Show's final version was certified Platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America in April 2013.

Old Crow Medicine Show is an Americana string band based in Nashville that has been recording since 1998.
